notes: New games, powered by pip install games. Every game is now pip's version: smarter computer opponents that keep getting harder as you win (no more ceiling at level 8, and the level you reached carries over), a new games room with pip's game icons grouped into Board, Cards, Sports, Puzzles and Luck, and a felt table with a wooden rail around every game. Three new games: Nonogram (paint the hidden picture from the number clues, hundreds of levels), Solitaire (every deal can be won) and Yaniv. Sudoku now has a fixed list of levels you can pick from, starting about as hard as the level you had reached. Hints are built in. In chats, checkers has a new wooden board with 3D pieces and crowned kings, chess turns round for whoever plays Black, and backgammon and the card tables got pip's finishing touches. Games already running in a chat carry on exactly as before.
